actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The goliath makes two attacks with
either its battleaxe or javelin.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5
ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8
(1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.text:
Melee or Ranged Weap on Attack: +5 to hit,
reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 feet, one target. Hit: 6
(1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
